_note: Week of September 14-20, 2026 — an energy experiment for Jake: breakfast + two smaller lunches instead of skipping breakfast and eating one big lunch, testing whether it helps his energy. Laine's breakfast/lunch routine is unchanged. Dinners are built around Monday's long day (frozen Bertolli bagged pasta + a Taylor Farms salad bag, ~15 min, nothing to prep), an easy sheet-pan run Tuesday-Friday (Wednesday and Friday keep the standing fish-night rule), and more involved weekend dinners — Saturday vegetarian stuffed shells, Sunday shakshuka for breakfast-for-dinner. Weekends are fully planned this week: Saturday is avocado toast + a grilled chicken salad, Sunday is bagels & lox + a chickpea salad. No mushrooms, lentils, okra, eggplant, or farro; onion cooked in, never raw. Jake's Lunch 2 is intentionally off the Mediterranean palette (Southwest black bean & turkey) since recent weeks leaned Mediterranean hard.

dinners.name: Bertolli Frozen Pasta + Taylor Farms Salad Bag
dinners.note: Long day for both of you — nothing to cook, nothing to prep. Pick whichever Bertolli bag looks good; no need for a specific variety.

ingredients.item: Bertolli frozen pasta bag — Jake 2 cups prepared, Laine 1¼ cups
Taylor Farms ready-to-go salad bag — Jake 1 serving, Laine ¾ serving

steps: Cook the Bertolli bag per package instructions (stovetop skillet, ~10 min).
Toss the Taylor Farms salad bag with its included dressing.
Portion — Jake gets the bigger share of both.

dinners.name: Sheet Pan Pork Tenderloin, Sweet Potato & Carrots
dinners.note: Not a fish night. Prep Monday night: marinate the pork and chop the sweet potato and carrots, fridge it — straight into the oven tonight.

ingredients.item: Sweet potato — Jake 1½ medium, Laine 1 medium, cubed
Olive oil — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Monday night: whisk olive oil, garlic, and spice mix. Toss the pork tenderloin in it, and cube the sweet potato and carrots. Fridge everything separately.
Tuesday: toss the sweet potato and carrots with a little more oil, spread on a sheet pan, roast at 425°F 15 min.
Push the vegetables aside, add the marinated pork. Roast another 18-20 min until the pork hits 145°F.
Rest the pork 5 min, slice, and serve.

dinners.name: Sheet Pan Salmon with Broccoli, Cherry Tomatoes & Quinoa

ingredients.item: Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp

steps: Cook the quinoa.
Toss broccoli and cherry tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, and half the dill on a sheet pan. Roast at 400°F 8 min.
Push vegetables aside, add the salmon, drizzle with lemon juice and remaining dill.
Roast another 12-15 min until the salmon flakes easily. Serve over quinoa.

dinners.name: Sheet Pan Honey-Mustard Chicken Thighs with Broccoli & Carrots

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — Jake 260g, Laine 180g raw
Honey — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 1½ tsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp

steps: Whisk honey, dijon, olive oil, and garlic into a glaze.
Toss the chicken thighs in the glaze, place on a sheet pan with broccoli and carrots.
Roast at 425°F 22-25 min until chicken hits 165°F, tossing vegetables halfway.

dinners.name: Sheet Pan Cod with Zucchini & Cherry Tomatoes
dinners.note: Second fish night, last sheet pan of the week.

ingredients.item: Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Toss zucchini and cherry tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, and spice mix on a sheet pan. Roast at 400°F 8 min.
Push vegetables aside, add the cod, drizzle with lemon juice.
Roast another 10-12 min until the cod flakes easily.

dinners.name: Three-Cheese Vegetable Stuffed Shells
dinners.note: Vegetarian night — more involved, worth the extra time on a weekend.

ingredients.item: Ricotta cheese, part-skim — Jake ¾ cup, Laine ½ cup
Shredded cheese (4-blend) — Jake 4 tbsp, Laine 3 tbsp
Roasted onion & garlic pasta sauce — Jake 1 cup, Laine ¾ cup
Italian dressing (light) — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1½ tbsp

steps: Boil the pasta shells until just al dente. Drain and cool slightly.
Mix ricotta, half the shredded cheese, and the chopped spinach. Season with salt and pepper.
Stuff each shell with the ricotta mixture, arrange in a baking dish over a layer of pasta sauce.
Top with remaining sauce and shredded cheese. Bake at 375°F, covered, 25 min, then uncovered 5 min.
Serve with the side salad, dressed.

dinners.name: Shakshuka with Feta & Toast
dinners.note: Breakfast-for-dinner — eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce.

ingredients.item: Diced tomatoes, canned — Jake 1½ cups, Laine scant 1¼ cups
Yellow onion — Jake ¼ cup, Laine scant ¼ cup, diced and cooked
Feta cheese, reduced fat — Jake 25g, Laine 20g, crumbled
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Whole grain bread — Jake 2 slices, Laine 1½ slices

steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add diced tomatoes and spice mix, simmer 8-10 min until slightly thickened.
Make wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 6-8 min until whites are set.
Top with crumbled feta. Serve with toasted bread for scooping.

jakeBreakfast.name: Egg White & Turkey Sausage Muffins
jakeBreakfast.note: New this week — Sunday-batch, 5 servings, same every weekday. Testing whether a real breakfast helps energy. Bell pepper and onion cooked in, a little sweet potato mixed in for real carbs, not just protein.

ingredients.item: Liquid egg whites — 1 cup per day (5 cups total)
Turkey breakfast sausage — 110g per day, cooked and crumbled
Yellow onion — ~20g per day, diced and cooked
Sweet potato — ~50g per day, diced small and pre-cooked
Olive oil — 1 tsp per day, for the pan

steps: Dice and pre-cook the sweet potato (steam or microwave until just tender).
Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft. Stir in the diced sweet potato.
Whisk egg whites, pour into a greased muffin tin or baking dish with the vegetable-sausage mixture and crumbled turkey sausage.
Top with cheddar. Bake at 350°F 18-20 min until set.
Portion into 5 containers, refrigerate.

jakeLunch.name: Chicken Thigh & Quinoa Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Lunch 1 of 2. Sunday-batch, 5 containers, no fish. Reheat-friendly, saucy, broccoli not spinach.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — 150g raw per container (~1.65 lbs total)
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — 1 tsp per container

steps: Cook all the quinoa at once.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and spice mix into a marinade. Toss the cubed chicken thighs in it.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add broccoli and bell pepper, stir-fry 4-5 min until just tender.
Divide quinoa and the chicken-vegetable mixture evenly across 5 containers.

jakeLunch2.name: Southwest Black Bean & Turkey Salad
jakeLunch2.note: Lunch 2 of 2. Cold, no reheat needed — off the Mediterranean palette on purpose. Avocado added fresh each morning. Sunday-batch, 5 containers.

ingredients.item: Black beans — ¼ can per container, rinsed
Avocado — ½ avocado per container, added fresh when eating
Cumin/paprika/garlic powder/salt spice mix — 1 tsp per container

steps: Grill or pan-sear the turkey breast, let cool, dice.
Cook the corn if using frozen (quick blanch or sauté).
Layer each container: black beans, corn, bell pepper, diced turkey, cotija.
Portion the lime juice and spice mix into a small separate container per lunch.
To eat: add dressing and fresh-cut avocado, toss, eat cold.

laineLunch.name: Cold Tuna & Black Bean Mason Jar
laineLunch.dressingNote: Olive oil + lemon juice, kept separate and added just before eating.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Black beans — ~¼ can per jar, rinsed
Avocado — ½ avocado per jar, added fresh when eating
Olive oil — 1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)
Lemon juice — scant ½ tbsp per jar

steps: Drain tuna, rinse black beans. Dice cucumber and bell pepper.
Layer each jar: black beans → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper.
Portion the dressing into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: add dressing and fresh-cut avocado, stir, eat straight from the jar.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Spinach & Feta Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Same-day cooked, so no reheating issue.

ingredients.item: Pinch oregano, thyme, cumin, paprika, salt

steps: Sauté cherry tomatoes 1-2 min in a dry nonstick pan until they start to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with feta and a pinch of spice mix.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ¾ cucumber sliced + hummus for dipping.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

weekendMeals.name: Avocado Toast Bar
weekendMeals.note: Decorated-top avocado toast, Laine's favorite weekend breakfast. Extra egg on Jake's for protein.

ingredients.item: Sourdough bread — Jake 2 slices, Laine 1 slice, toasted
Everything bagel seasoning — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 1 tsp

steps: Soft-boil the eggs (6-7 min), cool, peel, halve.
Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt, spread on top.
Top with sliced radish, everything bagel seasoning, and the soft-boiled egg halves.

weekendMeals.name: Grilled Chicken & Greens Salad

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — Jake 180g, Laine 120g raw, grilled and sliced
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp

steps: Season and grill the chicken breast, let rest, slice.
Toss lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber with olive oil and lemon juice.
Top with sliced chicken.

weekendMeals.name: Bagels & Lox
weekendMeals.note: Laine's other weekend favorite. Capers, cucumber, and tomato stand in for raw onion.

ingredients.item: Plain bagel — Jake 1, Laine ¾, toasted
Cream cheese — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1½ tbsp
Capers — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp

steps: Toast and split the bagels. Spread with cream cheese.
Top with lox, sliced cucumber, tomato, capers, and fresh dill.

weekendMeals.name: Mediterranean Chickpea & Veggie Salad
weekendMeals.note: Light before the shakshuka dinner. Bell pepper stands in for raw onion.

ingredients.item: Garbanzo beans — Jake ½ can, Laine ⅓ can, rinsed
Feta cheese, reduced fat — Jake 30g, Laine 25g, crumbled
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp

steps: Combine garbanzo beans, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and bell pepper.
Toss with olive oil and lemon juice, top with crumbled feta.

Must Buy: Bertolli frozen pasta bag — 2 bags (Monday dinner)
Taylor Farms ready-to-go salad bag — 1-2 bags (Monday dinner)
Sweet potatoes — ~1.2 lb (Tuesday, Jake's breakfast batch)
Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — ~4.7 lbs (Thursday + Jake's lunch batch)
Eggs — 2 dozen (Sunday dinner, Jake's breakfast batch, Saturday breakfast)
